subject.title: bug: Duplicate messages sent to Slack

question: Should maintainers keep this issue open until the named Slack session is correlated with gateway logs and Slack message timestamps, or close it as likely covered by adjacent duplicate guards?
rationale: Current main has multiple overlapping duplicate protections, but the issue lacks the session-level evidence needed to identify a fixed root cause with high confidence.

options.title: Keep open for log correlation
options.body: Keep this issue open until gateway logs and Slack message IDs identify the exact duplicate path.

options.title: Close against adjacent fixes
options.body: Close as likely fixed by current duplicate guards despite the missing session correlation.

recommendation.title: Keep open for log correlation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until gateway logs and Slack message IDs identify the exact duplicate path.

likelyOwner.reason: He has direct history on the Slack draft-preview duplicate fix and is a good routing candidate for deciding whether adjacent guards are enough.
